CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  September 23, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room C of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – September 9, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the September 9, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the September 9, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chairman
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-123
  • 1210 North Atlantic Boulevard
  • Applicant: Michelle Bennett
  • Request: This is an application for removal of the existing red tile band
  and its replacement with a stucco band painted red on an existing 1-
  story commercial restaurant building known as ‘In-N-Out.’
  1
  09/23/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-094
  • 2025 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Paul Wu
  • Request: This is an application for a new wall sign on an existing 1-
  story commercial building known as ‘Diamond Tire Pros’ and refacing
  of existing freestanding sign located at the southwest corner of the
  property.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Adjust the spacing on the proposed wall sign in Elevation to
  match throughout.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Vice Chairman Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-061
  • 2301 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Ryan Ybarra
  • Request: This is an application for a new wall sign and canopy on an
  existing 1-story commercial restaurant building known as
  ‘Wienerschnitzel.’
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  2
  09/23/2025
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chairman
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-096
  • 1108 South Vega Street
  • Applicant: Joseph Rappa
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  1-story Ranch style single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-067
  • 937 North Granada Avenue
  • Applicant: Lori Pazula
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  1-story Ranch style single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Update the drawings by omitting any references to the scope
  that are not listed in the scope of work on the Title Sheet.

  3
  09/23/2025
   2. Provide a note on the drawings that state any patch work
  where new wall infill occurs to match adjacent walls in both
  material and color.

  •  Moved by Vice Chairman Udani, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  AGENDA
  ITEM 7:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-115
  • 1400 Milton Avenue
  • Applicant: Artin Grigori
  • Request: This is an application for a new front covered porch and re-
  roofing on an existing 1-story Colonial style single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Update the proposed elevations to accurately show the
  location of the existing exterior light fixture.
  2. Update the graphics in elevation to show the proposed brick
  material on the porch piers.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

  4
  09/23/2025
 F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:42 P.M. to Tuesday,
  October 14, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez
  Chairman

_______________________
